Privacy Policy

Last updated: 18 November 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Bharat Gold Buyer ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects your information when you use https://www.bharatgoldbuyer.com or sell gold, silver, diamonds or coins at our store.

Information We Collect

When you submit an enquiry form, we collect your name, phone number and what you wish to sell, solely to respond to your enquiry. When you sell at our store, we are required by law to record KYC details (photo ID, and PAN for transactions of ₹2 lakh and above) and transaction particulars on your invoice.

How We Use It

To respond to enquiries, complete your transaction, issue invoices, and meet legal and regulatory obligations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties, and we do not send marketing messages without your consent.

Cookies & Analytics

This website uses Google Tag Manager / analytics cookies to understand aggregate usage. You may disable cookies in your browser settings.

Data Security & Retention

Transaction records are retained as required by Indian law. Enquiry data is kept only as long as needed to serve your request.

Contact

For any privacy question, email bharatgoldbuyer@gmail.com or call +91 9990780499.
